subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Nickel or brass can cause an allergic reaction when in ______ with human skin.
solution:
The correct answer is "**contact**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, the blank will imply how that when nickel or brass touches the skin it causes allergic reaction.**
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "contact."**
 
 
• "Contact" means touching or meeting with something.(स्पर्श)
 
 
• ​Example: This product should not come in contact with the eyes.
 
 
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate word to use in the given sentence.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "surface", refers to the outer layer or top of something. It is not as appropriate as "contact" in this sentence because it does not convey the idea of direct touch. (सतह)
 
• - Option 2, "accordance", means agreement or conformity. It is not at all appropriate in this sentence.(अनुसार)
 
• - Option 3, "parallel", means side by side and never touching. It is not at all appropriate in this sentence.(समानांतर)
